summary: Two resizable panes with a separator operable by pointer and keyboard.
whenToUse: Showing an editor and a preview side by side.
whenNotToUse: Static layouts that already adapt with Grid or Stack.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation of the separator and the split.

props.name: primarySize / defaultPrimarySize
props.description: Controlled or initial size of the primary pane, as a percentage.

props.name: minPrimarySize / maxPrimarySize
props.description: Percentage limits of the primary pane.

keyboard.action: Resize the primary pane; Shift increases the step.
Jump to the minimum and maximum limits.

accessibility: The separator exposes its role, orientation, value, and limits through ARIA.
Both panes have a configurable accessible name.
responsive: Inner content scrolls within its own pane; switch orientation on narrow layouts.
customization: Uses the --dc-color-* tokens and the intrinsic size of the content.
commonMistakes: Give the container a height when using orientation="horizontal".
limits: Does not persist sizes or handle mobile layouts automatically.
